name: Artemida Termiya
source:
Artemis is the goddess of the hunt who had control over the cult I fought against last month. She said she doesn't care about that cult and that she didn't even control it. She also revealed that her only goal is to create the perfect hunter or huntress. Therefore, she wants a child from [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url].
